updates.description: Every TIED client repository SHALL migrate through controlled, evidence-backed phases until fleet-migrated-client or a time-bounded migration waiver. Phase 1 establishes product contract and governance schemas. Phase 2 establishes analyzer and template readiness at G1 advisory. Phase 3 validates pilot migration workflow (stdd wave 1 + external scan), REQ-PSEUDOCODE_MIGRATION_TOOLING, G2 receipts, and rollback—without fleet-wide migration or G3 CI defaults.
